decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program is close to the firm's core door business and its logistics competence, so in-house R&D and related knowledge let it interpret results and refine the offer, and it stayed visible through 2024.

The seventy-two-hour delivery program builds directly on existing production and spare-parts logistics, so the firm can learn from early results, though its demanding operations carry slightly more risk of being consolidated into the broader express line.
The express product line for doors and gates has its own page and several models, sits squarely within the firm's established knowledge, and shows sustained commitment.

The digital ordering platform extends the firm's service and trade-partner relationships, and its own page in both years together with the firm's R&D capacity supports continued assimilation and improvement.

The fire and smoke protection door matches the firm's safety-compliance expertise and was promoted to its own page in 2024, signalling growing commitment despite the earlier withdrawal of a related fire door.
